cause_quote: The child-session feature put the live `<openclaw-elapsed-time>` inside `<span class="session-row-trail" id=${metaId ?? nothing}>` and skipped the actions for child rows with `${session.isChild ? nothing`, leaving the trailing column sized by the clock text.
user_saw: When a running child session's elapsed label changed from 9s to 10s, the label shifted and the sidebar title lost space.
summary: The fix gives the elapsed label a 7ch minimum slot and aligns its text to the leading edge.
reasoning: I checked the child-session introduction diff and its stylesheet, which placed the ticking label in an auto-sized, end-aligned column with no reserved width. The clock was present in that layout from its first sidebar release, and the later row styling and offscreen clock changes did not introduce the width dependency.
